eval.question: Our teams can't tell who owns most of our cloud spend. Which single FinOps capability addresses assigning costs to responsible teams, and what are three characteristics of a Crawl-level practice in it?
eval.expected: Capability: allocation. Any three Crawl characteristics from the official maturity assessment, e.g.: simple allocation strategy mapping accounts/projects/subscriptions to business units or cost centers; allocation/tagging strategy defined but compliance inconsistent; shared costs not identified beyond common charges; a substantial portion of costs can be allocated directly.
eval.expected_calls: search_framework then get_maturity_assessment (or get_capability include maturity)

eval.question: What does a Walk-level Sustainability practice look like? Quote two statements from the official maturity assessment.
eval.expected: Two verbatim statements from the official Sustainability Walk-level assessment, e.g.: "All engineering teams and most other Personas involved in technology usage are aware of their potential impact on corporate sustainability goals"; "Technology teams have a variety of mechanisms to reduce carbon use through optimization efforts across multiple technology domains" (any two exact statements from that assessment text are acceptable, quoted verbatim).

eval.question: Which FinOps Domain does Anomaly Management belong to, and which other capabilities live in the same domain?
eval.expected: Domain: Understand Usage & Cost (understand-usage-and-cost). Other capabilities: Data Ingestion, Allocation, Reporting & Analytics.

eval.question: List the featured KPIs on the Forecasting capability page (slugs or titles).
eval.expected: Exactly four: Forecast Accuracy Rate for Carbon Emissions, Forecast Accuracy Rate (Spend), Forecast Accuracy Rate (Usage), Forecast Drift Rate (slugs: forecast-accuracy-rate-for-carbon-emissions, forecast-accuracy-rate-spend, forecast-accuracy-rate-usage, forecast-drift-rate).
eval.expected_calls: get_kpis(capability: "forecasting", featured_only: true) or get_capability include kpis

eval.question: What is the formula of the "Allocation Accuracy Index (AAI)" KPI, and which capabilities does the FinOps Foundation officially relate it to?
eval.expected: Formula: AAI = (Directly Attributed Costs / Total Infrastructure Costs) × 100. Officially related capabilities: Reporting & Analytics, Usage Optimization, Allocation.

eval.question: According to the official FinOps maturity model, what sample goal does the FinOps community give for cost allocation coverage at Crawl level?
eval.expected: Able to allocate at least 70% of cost to a known owner. (Context from the same level: ~60% commitment discount coverage; forecast variance below 20%.)
eval.expected_calls: search_framework(maturity) or get_framework_info then reading maturity content via get_actions is wrong — the maturity-model sample goals come from search_framework(entity_types:["maturity-level"]) or the maturity-model resource; tools-only path: search_framework

eval.question: Which FinOps Principle does the Allocation capability's definition explicitly say it enables?
eval.expected: "Everyone takes ownership for their technology usage."
eval.expected_calls: get_capability(capability: "allocation") — default include contains the definition

eval.question: Among these three capabilities — Allocation, Budgeting, Rate Optimization — in which does the Procurement persona have individually named functional activities?
eval.expected: Budgeting and Rate Optimization, but NOT Allocation (Allocation's activities name other core personas and the allied group, not Procurement).

eval.question: How many entries does this server's KPI library contain in total, and which KPIs officially related to Unit Economics measure (a) cost per API call and (b) cost per gigabyte stored?
eval.expected: 88 total. (a) cost-per-api-call ("Cost per API Call"); (b) cost-per-gigabytes-stored ("Cost per Gigabytes Stored").

eval.question: How many maturity levels does the official FinOps model define, and what are they?
eval.expected: Exactly three: Crawl, Walk, Run. The server must not volunteer "Pre-Crawl" as part of the official model — it is an unofficial extension that only appears (labeled official: false) when FINOPS_MCP_EXPERIMENTAL is set, and the default surface should not mention it at all.
